rows.scope: A83 stopped compare r11 at its freeze, before its recheck lenses ran, and made Claude3 and Codex2 the rechecks (reviews) of record; it stopped the c2v007 own-check workflow and made Codex2's review the check of record (rehearsal R-02). Both r4 slot rules named the stopped checks; r5 names the checks of record.

rows.reason: no change, because A84 schedules speculative r6 identity runs, concurrent lane work and Codex3's step-5 readiness; it changes no rule of this text, and A96 later made r6 moot (r5's r6 edits are traced to A96).

rows.reason: no change, because A85.2-A85.4 (core priority, internal-volume step-2 outputs, caffeinate) are RUNBOOK root steps at launch that change no sealed byte (A85), now carried by BUILD_V007 (V6-S2, A99.1); A85.1 (the parallel tail build) adopts nothing before the seal under the A72 rule and is moot for V007 (A96).

rows.scope: A86.1 makes GQ_CERT_V006 (5a1b39f8) the GQ record of record (V005 fbceefe6 reads RECORD_DEFECT under A79.1, which stands); A86 makes Claude3 and Codex2 the r11 reviews of record. A86.2 (the open V005 path: no compare change), A86.3 (RI-24 fields only under r6: moot, A96), A86.4 (DOUBLING NGC K_big informational) and A86.5 (NEW-71 to NEW-81 under RI-10, already seal_record_requirements[5]) need no text.

rows.heading: ## A87: missing pre-seal records of record, and their owners (Claude3 0075) (2026-10-18 18:33Z)
rows.scope: A87 names the missing pre-seal records of record and their owners: the merged DOUBLING record (ea48ac2b), the B3 FIELDS-shape JSON (the 465cb3c3 Markdown is the human report), LO_NGC_CERT_V002 (33bc2190) as the LO_NGC record of record, the B0-family records, and the post-seal producers in a new BUILD.

rows.heading: ## A88: SR_K is produced after the seal by the sealed producers (Codex1 0054) (2026-10-18 18:36Z)
rows.scope: A88 moves SR_K after the seal (produced by the sealed pinned producers before any T-run output is read; registered by producer pins with PRODUCED_AFTER_THE_SEAL), amending A79 NEW-61 for SR_K only. r4 required the SR_K record before the seal.

rows.heading: ## A89: measured KHI cost; the A72(c) criterion made concrete (2026-10-18 18:42Z)
rows.scope: A89 measures the KHI cost (7.84-13.86 h solo; the 27.84 h preview is superseded) and makes A72(c) concrete (r6 only with no seal delay); A96 then applies it.

rows.heading: ## A90: compare r11 reviews; NGC K32 N-tests complete (2026-10-18 18:49Z)
rows.scope: A90 records Codex2's blocking r11 item (r12 follows) and makes LO_NGC_K32_CERT_V001 (07745bbf) the NGC N-test record while V007 keeps LO_NGC V002. Its NGC N-test outcome (N_FAIL_N1 on TRUNCATION_SHAPE only; route A/B OPEN under A66) and its step-5 open item change no registered N-test, threshold or consequence of this text.

rows.heading: ## A91: the r12 scope is final; c2v007 digest presence (2026-10-18 18:54Z)
rows.scope: A91 fixes the r12 scope (0459, 0462's should-fix, A88 SR_K; the RI-24 fields only under r6) and its delta reviews (Codex2, Claude3; 0 blocking each), and makes identity-digest presence a requirement of c2v007r2.

rows.heading: ## A92: r5 identity gates PASS under c2v007r2 (2026-10-18 19:16Z)
rows.scope: A92 rules c2v007r2 (052da0fe) the identity-comparator slot and the R5_V001 records (B1 83e7b067, B1_OFF 3b9ad402, B0prime_RERUN e33af53d) the identity records of record for driver r5.

rows.heading: ## A93: NGC cx3r007 accepted (Claude4 0092) (2026-10-18 19:31Z)
rows.scope: A93 accepts NGC cx3r007 and makes SPEC_REGISTRY_CX3R007 (cd30429c) the step-5 launch registry, retiring 3c42ca07. The NGC launch path stays outside this text; r5 corrects the registry named in the scope note.

rows.heading: ## A94: B2 follows its controlling text exactly (Codex2 0480) (2026-10-18 19:40Z)
rows.scope: A94 rules that B2 follows its controlling text exactly: full static rows with the registered gas rule, le3 for every case, the named statistic, the basis stated, interpretations listed as ROOT_ITEMs.

rows.heading: ## A95: Codex3 resumed; taskpolicy in sandboxes; a threading clarification (2026-10-18 19:46Z)
rows.reason: no change, because A95 makes taskpolicy -b preferred rather than required in lane work and limits six-thread Accelerate to non-production measurement (production stays single-thread BLAS); this text has no clause on lane process priority or BLAS threading, and A85.2's step-2 rule stays a RUNBOOK root step.

rows.scope: A96: V007 seals on driver v010 r5 (b5cc62af); r6 is deferred and unused; A81 RI-24 and the conditional cache slot are moot; compare r12 cx3v002 (4bd7b262) is frozen, with Claude3's and Codex2's delta reviews of record.

rows.heading: ## A97: the B2 sanity clause fails as written. Diagnose it before anything else (2026-10-18 20:02Z, before any T result)
rows.scope: A97 fixes, before the decomposition, the rule by which B2's sanity clause is read ((a) the like-for-like reference with the 0.05 unchanged, (b) fail, (c) C3R3 computed the same way or INCOMPLETE), and holds the seal for B2.

rows.reason: no change, because A98's PAR-TB ruling concerns the NGC v011 successors (step 5) and its miss-reading prereg r3 item is on the step-6 path; neither is V007 text.

rows.heading: ## A99: the seal rehearsal's rulings (Claude4 0099) (2026-10-18 20:20Z)
revised_clauses: SEAL_CHECKLIST_R5 A11, A12, B1, B2a, B8
rows.scope: A99 (the rehearsal rulings): BUILD_V007 is the launch-packet BUILD of record (D-02); Claude4 builds the case block, pinned as binding_inputs.case_block (D-03); this entry table (item 3); seal tools v002 (item 4, not text); V6-N2 closed in r12 and BUILD_V007's post-seal producers in the registry (item 5); root writes nothing to V005 after the freeze (item 6).

rows.heading: ## A100: B2 is disposed under A97(a) (2026-10-18 20:24Z, before any T result)
rows.scope: A100 disposes B2 under A97(a): the like-for-like reference (ADV's method with production's continuum_v001 gas rule), the 0.05 unchanged, the values of record (reading (ii), P16: 0.0301 / 0.0356 / 0.0384 km/s), the disclosure block repeated in the seal record, and the limit that B2 does not prove shared physical correctness.

rows.heading: ## A101: B2 record of record; registry V008 (2026-10-18 20:48Z)
rows.scope: A101 makes B2_GATE_RECORD_C3V003 (915fbcda) the B2 record of record with its two documentation errata carried in the seal record, records Codex2 0507 PASS (zero findings) on the case block CASE_BLOCK_V007_C4V001 (76309ae3) pinned here, and makes registry V008 (f189cd3f) final pending V009 with BUILD_V007's producers. Its step-5 star-transform result (the A90 open item, closed) is outside this text.

This table covers A82-A101, the newest at r5 generation; the seal record quotes it; any later entry needs a successor revision or an explicit seal-record note (A81 RI-26).
